title: Sanger Tree of Life RNA Extraction: Automated MagMax™ mirVana
author: Raquel Juliana Vionette do Amaral

steps.title: Prepare TURBO DNase solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the TURBO DNase solution and store on wet ice.

substeps.instruction: Combine 60 µL MagMAX TURBO DNase Buffer per sample
Combine 2.5 µL Turbo DNase (from freezer) per sample

steps.title: Prepare Binding Beads Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Binding Beads Mix and store on wet ice.

substeps.instruction: Combine 12 µL RNA binding beads per sample
Combine 12 µL Lysis/binding enhancer (from freezer) per sample

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Create sufficient lysis buffer for the samples based on the requirement of 40 µL per 1 mg of tissue (600 µL per 15 mg sample).

substeps.instruction: Combine 1000 µL Lysis Buffer per sample
Combine 0.7 µL DTT per sample

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Process 15 mg of tissue using one of the following methods based on sample preparation:

substeps.instruction: For powermashing: Transfer 15 mg tissue into a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube, add 600 µL lysis buffer, and disrupt using a PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain.
For cryoprepped samples: Transfer 15 mg cryoprepped tissue into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 600 µL lysis buffer, and pipette to homogenize.

steps.title: Lyse Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at room temperature for 30 seconds to 1 minute to allow lysis. Place samples on ice if they will not immediately proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of each sample into individual wells of a Thermo Fisher KingFisher™ 1 mL 96-well deep-well plate.

steps.title: Add Isopropanol and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of isopropanol to each sample, seal the plate, and shake at room temperature on a plate shaker for 2 minutes at 950 rpm.

steps.title: Add Binding Beads and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of the prepared binding beads mix to each sample, re-seal the plate, and mix at room temperature on a plate shaker for 5 minutes at 950 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Processing Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the processing plates for the KingFisher™ Apex protocol as follows:

substeps.instruction: Sample Plate (Pos 1, Deep-well): 200 µL sample + 100 µL isopropanol + 20 µL binding beads mix
Wash Plate 1 (Pos 2, Deep-well): 150 µL Wash solution 1
Wash Plate 2 (Pos 3, Deep-well): 150 µL Wash solution 1
DNase Plate (Pos 4, Deep-well): 50 µL TURBO DNase solution
Wash Plate 3 (Pos 5, Deep-well): 150 µL Wash solution 2
Wash Plate 4 (Pos 6, Deep-well): 150 µL Wash solution 2
Elution plate (Pos 7, Standard 200 µL): 50 µL Elution buffer
Tip Comb (Pos 8, Deep-well): Place a tip comb in the plate

steps.title: Run KingFisher Apex Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the RNA Extraction Protocol Script on the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the protocol from the list and press the play button.
Load processing plates and sample plate in the prompted positions and start the run (total time approx. 50 minutes).

steps.title: Perform Mid-Run Reagent Addition
steps.instruction: When the protocol pauses after 30 minutes, quickly add reagents to the DNase plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the DNase plate from the instrument.
Add 50 µL rebinding buffer and 100 µL absolute isopropanol to each well containing sample separately (do not premix).
Load the DNase plate back into the instrument and press run to resume.

steps.title: Collect and Store Eluates
steps.instruction: Remove the elution plate at the end of the run and store on ice.

substeps.instruction: Pipette eluates into microcentrifuge tubes.
Perform required QC.
Store eluates at –80°C.

steps.title: Remove Residual Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Inspect elution plates for remaining magnetic beads. If beads are present (common in viscous samples), recover the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and place on a magnetic rack.
Allow approximately 5 minutes for beads to migrate.
Pipette out the clear eluate containing the RNA.
